bagPolicy.summary: Fans can bring one clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bag not exceeding 12″ x 6″ x 12”, a one-gallon clear plastic freezer bag, or a small clutch bag no larger than 4.5″ x 6.5″. Exceptions are made for medically necessary items after inspection.
allowed: Bags that are clear plastic, vinyl or PVC and do not exceed 12″ x 6″ x 12”
One-gallon clear plastic freezer bag (Ziploc bag or similar)
Small clutch bags approximately the size of a hand but not larger than 4.5″ x 6.5″
prohibited: Purses larger than a clutch bag
Any bag larger than the permissible size
bagPolicy.note: An exception can be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection.

parking.note: Lincoln Financial Field offers various parking options with different rates for Eagles games, concerts, and other events. Regular vehicles are charged $50 for Eagles games, $40 for concerts, and $30 for other events, while oversized vehicles are charged $100, $80, and $60 respectively. Traffic patterns are directed by the Philadelphia Police to ensure efficient exit from the Sports Complex.

rideshare.note: Meet your rideshare at the northeast corner of Broad Street and Pattison Avenue, next to the Broad Street Line subway station.

concessions.note: Lincoln Financial Field offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including exclusive club level offerings like Jerk Chicken Sandwiches and Philly Pressed Italiano Sandwiches. Local favorites feature iconic Philadelphia flavors such as cheesesteaks and Chickie’s & Pete’s CrabFries.
stands: Aussie Meat Pies by G’Day Gourmet

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: North Gate is the designated ADA gate for expedited entry, and guests with disabilities can also use the Tork and Hyundai VIP entrances. The stadium has accessible parking, drop-off areas, seating, assistive listening devices, and mobile event captioning devices. Service dogs and service dogs in training are allowed; for ADA accommodations, call Guest Services at 215.463.5500.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: You can't exit and re-enter with the same ticket. In an emergency, a Gate Chief may scan you out and allow re-entry at the same gate, and you will go through security again.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call always opens at least 3 hours prior to kickoff. Will Call – The Will Call windows are located at the northwest side of the HeadHouse Plaza, next to the XFINITY Gate (formerly Comcast Gate).

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: North Gate is the designated ADA gate. The East Club & Suite Entrance and Hyundai Club & Suite Entrance are only for suite members, club seat members, and fans with disabilities.
